input.summary: V02 Tungabhadra Actives quoted 7 lines (RM-001 to RM-006, RM-009, RM-010), declined RM-007 hydroxyethylcellulose as not available, and did not mention RM-008 rosemary extract; RM-004 is a 75% panthenol solution in water versus the 98% active spec, and the peptides are distributor-sourced from a confidential overseas manufacturer with no temperature logger and refused rejection/delivery record sharing; a 4% trade discount applies to RM-001 to RM-005 above Rs 2,00,000 per line, and one niacinamide COA (batch NIA-2603-07, assay 99.4%) was saved.
